title: A weakly supervised deep learning framework for automated PD-L1 expression analysis in lung cancer.
summary: Weakly supervised multiple-instance learning estimated lung-cancer PD-L1 scores with pathologist agreement in internal and external patient cohorts. The bibliographic records retrieved do not state an author affiliation.
ai_technology: ResNet18 plus attention and multiple-instance learning use slide-level pathologist labels; patient-level split produced internal and external evaluation.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Pathologist-referenced TPS validation reports ICC 0.960 and external accuracy 81.7%; diagnostic assistance only, with prospective utility untested.
evidence.unknown: Weakly supervised multiple-instance learning estimated lung-cancer PD-L1 scores with pathologist agreement in internal and external patient cohorts. Primary Results describe the specific comparator, cohort or experimental check; limitations are stated narrowly.
